description: For a webhook subscription that is still pending: Mercatura POSTs its check now ({ "type": "mercatura.webhook.verify", "nonce" }) and the subscription is active once the endpoint answers { "verify": <hex HMAC-SHA256 of the nonce, keyed with the secret> }. token: the unsubscribe token the subscription was given.
name: alerts_verify_webhook
title: Alerts: verify a pending webhook now
